skill.name: span_first_rotor_sizing
skill.description: Size rotor diameter to meet span limit first, then upsize power system
skill.content: When a max span/gate limit applies, fit geometry first: choose rotor_diameter so that predicted span < limit (use span ~2.5x rotor_diameter for a quad, smaller allowance per rotor as n_rotors grows). Shrinking rotors raises disk loading and hover power as ~1/sqrt(area), so compensate by upsizing battery kWh for endurance and motors+battery-C for >=1.5x hover power and thrust/weight >=1.5.

skill.name: split_disk_area_to_fit_span
skill.description: Add rotors to fit span limit while preserving disk area for downwash/power
skill.content: When span is over limit but downwash/power needs large disk area, increase rotor count (e.g. 2->6-8) and shrink diameter to hold total area A=n*pi*d^2/4 roughly constant. Downwash and hover power follow momentum theory v=sqrt(W/(2*rho*A)), so constant A keeps them safe while span scales ~sqrt(n)*d and shrinks; always retarget thrust/weight to >=1.6 and power to >=1.6x hover to avoid borderline 1.50 rounding fails.

skill.name: keep_1p5x_thrust_and_power_margins
skill.description: Guarantee lift and electrical headroom on powered-lift designs
skill.content: Size the propulsion system so max thrust / weight >=1.5, total motor power >=1.5x hover power, and battery max discharge >=1.5x hover power. Apply all three checks together before submitting; if any fails, upsize rotors/motors/battery respectively rather than trading one margin for another.

skill.name: choose_battery_by_required_c_rate
skill.description: Select battery chemistry by required discharge C-rate when sizing for endurance
skill.content: For battery-powered hover/lift machines, size chemistry for power as well as energy: required C = (1.5 x hover_power_kW) / battery_kWh must be < chemistry continuous C-rating. When endurance needs <1 kWh but hover needs ~1 kW, required C is ~2-3C so choose Li-ion (~4C) over higher-energy Li-S (~1.5C), otherwise battery_power fails despite passing endurance.

def design(brief, tools):
    import math
    payload = float(brief.get("payload_kg", 1.0))
    max_span = float(brief.get("max_span_m", 2.5))
    distance = brief.get("distance_km", None)
    wind = float(brief.get("wind_m_s", 0.0))
    rain = bool(brief.get("rain", False))
    planet = brief.get("planet", "earth")
    if planet == "mars":
        rho = 0.020
        g = 3.71
    elif planet == "titan":
        rho = 5.40
        g = 1.35
    else:
        rho = float(brief.get("air_density", 1.225))
        g = float(brief.get("gravity", 9.81))

    # mission cruise: need ground speed >0, energy optimal ~1.5*headwind
    # headwind averaged 0.7*wind
    if distance is not None:
        hw = 0.7 * wind
        cruise = hw + 12.5
        # optimal leans to ~1.5*hw, blend
        opt = 1.5 * hw + 5.0
        # weighted toward opt for efficiency
        cruise = (cruise + opt) / 2.0
        if wind >= 20:
            cruise = hw + 14.0  # ensure progress in hurricane
        cruise = max(5.0, min(60.0, cruise))
    else:
        cruise = 15.0

    # rotors: maximize disk area within span
    # assume span ~ sqrt(n)*D / duct_factor, ducted helps
    ducted = True
    # need gust T/W = 1.5+wind/40, high wind wants more disk + power
    if wind >= 20 or (distance is not None and distance >= 30):
        n_rotors = 8
    elif wind >= 10 or payload >= 2.0:
        n_rotors = 8
    else:
        n_rotors = 6

    duct_factor = 0.8 if ducted else 1.0
    # D so that sqrt(n)*D*duct_factor <= max_span*0.9 (margin)
    D_fit = (max_span * 0.9) / (math.sqrt(n_rotors) * duct_factor)
    D_fit = max(0.2, min(1.5, D_fit))
    # in thin air need huge disks, in dense air smaller ok
    if rho < 0.1:
        D_fit = min(4.0, max(D_fit, 1.2))
    rotor_diameter_m = round(min(4.0, max(0.1, D_fit)), 3)

    # estimate mass & power iteratively to size battery/motor
    # mass model guesses (conservative)
    def mass_model(batt_kwh, motor_kw_each, n):
        # li-ion ~250Wh/kg => 4kg/kWh, frame carbon light, motor ~0.35kg/kW + ducts
        batt_mass = batt_kwh * 4.0
        if rain:
            batt_mass *= 1.0  # waterproofing handled in sim, add margin
            frame_extra = 0.5
        else:
            frame_extra = 0.0
        frame_mass = 1.5 + 0.25 * n + frame_extra
        motor_mass = n * motor_kw_each * 0.35
        duct_mass = n * 0.25 * (rotor_diameter_m ** 2) if ducted else 0.0
        return payload + frame_mass + motor_mass + duct_mass + batt_mass

    # initial motor guess, will bump up
    motor_power_kw = 2.0
    if payload >= 3 or wind >= 15:
        motor_power_kw = 2.5

    # hover power estimate via momentum: P = W^1.5/sqrt(2*rho*A)/FM
    def hover_power(mass):
        W = mass * g
        A = n_rotors * math.pi * rotor_diameter_m ** 2 / 4.0
        if ducted:
            FM = 0.75
            A_eff = A * 1.3
        else:
            FM = 0.65
            A_eff = A
        P = (W ** 1.5) / math.sqrt(2.0 * rho * A_eff) / FM
        return P  # watts

    # size battery for mission energy
    if distance is not None:
        # iterate battery size until energy closes
        batt = 2.0
        for _ in range(12):
            m = mass_model(batt, motor_power_kw, n_rotors)
            Ph = hover_power(m)  # W
            # forward power: induced ~ Ph*0.9 + parasite k*v^3
            # CdA guess ~0.15 + payload factor
            CdA = 0.12 + 0.03 * payload
            if ducted:
                CdA *= 0.9
            P_par = 0.5 * rho * (cruise ** 3) * CdA
            if rain:
                P_par *= 1.15
            P_cruise = Ph * 0.85 + P_par
            # extra for rain waterproof mass power already in mass? add 7%
            if rain:
                P_cruise *= 1.05
            gs = cruise - 0.7 * wind
            if gs < 3.0:
                gs = 3.0
            t_hr = (distance * 1000.0 / gs) / 3600.0
            t_hr += 2.0 / 60.0  # 2 min hover
            e_need = (P_cruise / 1000.0) * t_hr * 1.15  # 15% reserve
            e_need *= 1.25  # margin for model error + battery usable
            # hover 2min also at Ph
            batt = e_need
            if batt > 12.0:
                batt = 12.0
                break
        battery_kwh = round(min(12.0, max(0.5, batt)), 2)
        # re-check motor headroom >=1.5x hover with final mass
        m = mass_model(battery_kwh, motor_power_kw, n_rotors)
        Ph = hover_power(m)
        need_total_kw = (Ph * 1.8) / 1000.0  # 1.8x margin
        # gust climb also needs ~ (T/W)^1.5 factor
        tw = 1.5 + wind / 40.0
        need_gust_kw = (Ph * (tw ** 1.5) * 1.2) / 1000.0
        need_total_kw = max(need_total_kw, need_gust_kw)
        per = need_total_kw / n_rotors * 1.5  # extra margin
        motor_power_kw = round(max(motor_power_kw, per, 0.6), 2)
        # cap motor to reasonable (mass spiral)
        motor_power_kw = min(motor_power_kw, 4.0)
        # if motor grew, mass grew, bump battery 10%
        battery_kwh = round(min(12.0, battery_kwh * 1.1 + 0.1), 2)
    else:
        endurance = float(brief.get("endurance_min", 20.0))
        batt = 1.0
        for _ in range(8):
            m = mass_model(batt, motor_power_kw, n_rotors)
            Ph = hover_power(m)
            e_need = (Ph / 1000.0) * (endurance / 60.0) * 1.15 * 1.3
            batt = e_need
        battery_kwh = round(min(12.0, max(0.3, batt)), 2)
        m = mass_model(battery_kwh, motor_power_kw, n_rotors)
        Ph = hover_power(m)
        motor_power_kw = round(max(motor_power_kw, (Ph * 1.8 / 1000.0 / n_rotors) * 1.5), 2)

    battery_chemistry = "li-ion"  # best energy density for 45km
    # C-rate check: large kwh gives enough power; li-po only if tiny battery + huge power
    # keep li-ion for range; if battery small and hover big, switch to li-po
    m_final = mass_model(battery_kwh, motor_power_kw, n_rotors)
    Ph_final = hover_power(m_final)
    # rough C capability: li-ion ~3C, li-po ~8C
    if (battery_kwh * 1000.0 * 3.0 / 1000.0) < (Ph_final * 1.5 / 1000.0) and battery_kwh < 1.0:
        battery_chemistry = "li-po"

    frame_material = "carbon"
    cruise_speed_m_s = round(float(cruise), 2)

    return {
        "n_rotors": int(n_rotors),
        "rotor_diameter_m": float(rotor_diameter_m),
        "motor_power_kw": float(motor_power_kw),
        "battery_kwh": float(battery_kwh),
        "battery_chemistry": battery_chemistry,
        "frame_material": frame_material,
        "ducted": bool(ducted),
        "cruise_speed_m_s": float(cruise_speed_m_s),
    }

def design(brief, tools):
    import math
    payload = float(brief.get("payload_kg", 1.0))
    max_span = float(brief.get("max_span_m", 99.0))
    planet = brief.get("planet", "earth")
    g = float(brief.get("gravity", 9.81))
    rho = float(brief.get("air_density", 1.225))
    if planet == "mars" and "gravity" not in brief:
        g = 3.71
    if planet == "mars" and "air_density" not in brief:
        rho = 0.020
    if planet == "titan" and "gravity" not in brief:
        g = 1.35
    if planet == "titan" and "air_density" not in brief:
        rho = 5.40
    distance_km = brief.get("distance_km", None)
    wind = float(brief.get("wind_m_s", 0.0))
    rain = bool(brief.get("rain", False))
    endurance_need = brief.get("endurance_min", None)
    max_mass = brief.get("max_mass_kg", None)
    max_downwash = brief.get("max_downwash_m_s", None)
    max_thrust_kn = brief.get("max_thrust_kn", None)
    max_motor_kw = brief.get("max_motor_power_kw", None)

    headwind = 0.7 * wind
    gust_req = 1.5 + wind / 40.0

    # assumed component models (conservative, fitted to sim)
    e_dens = {"li-ion": 0.25, "li-po": 0.22, "li-s": 0.45}
    c_rate = {"li-ion": 4.0, "li-po": 8.0, "li-s": 2.8}
    frame_kg_per_m = {"carbon": 2.4, "aluminum": 3.6, "steel": 5.0}

    def span_est(n, d, ducted):
        side = int(math.ceil(math.sqrt(n)))
        gap = 0.30 if ducted else 0.20
        return side * (d + gap)

    def evaluate(n, d, mot_each, batt_kwh, chem, frame, ducted, vcruise):
        A = n * math.pi * d * d / 4.0
        batt_m = batt_kwh / e_dens[chem]
        mot_m = n * mot_each * 0.17
        rot_m = n * 0.35 * d * d
        duct_m = n * 1.10 * d * d if ducted else 0.0
        sp = span_est(n, d, ducted)
        frm_m = 1.0 + frame_kg_per_m[frame] * sp
        sub = payload + batt_m + mot_m + rot_m + duct_m + frm_m
        wp = 0.07 * sub if rain else 0.0
        M = sub + wp
        W = M * g
        # hover power momentum theory
        ideal = (W ** 1.5) / math.sqrt(2.0 * rho * A)
        fduct = 0.92 if ducted else 1.0
        Phov = ideal * 1.06 * fduct / 1000.0  # kW
        Ptotal = n * mot_each
        Pbatt = batt_kwh * c_rate[chem]
        Pav = Ptotal if Ptotal < Pbatt else Pbatt
        # max thrust from power
        s = math.sqrt(2.0 * rho * A)
        Tmax = ((Pav * 1000.0) * s) ** (2.0 / 3.0) * 0.97
        tw = Tmax / W if W > 0 else 0
        vh = W / (2.0 * rho * A)
        vh = math.sqrt(vh) if vh > 0 else 5.0
        downwash = vh * (2.0 if True else 2.0)
        # parasite
        CdA = 0.32 * ((M / 70.0) ** (2.0 / 3.0)) if M > 0 else 0.32
        CdA = max(CdA, 0.08)
        def cruise_power(v):
            Pind = Phov * 1.25 * 10.0 / (10.0 + v)
            Ppar = 0.5 * rho * v * v * v * CdA / 1000.0
            if rain:
                Ppar *= 1.15
            return Pind + Ppar
        end_usable = batt_kwh * 0.8
        end_min = end_usable / Phov * 60.0 if Phov > 0 else 0
        mission_ok = True
        energy_need = 0
        flight_min = 0
        Pc = 0
        gs = 0
        if distance_km is not None:
            v = vcruise
            gs = v - headwind
            if gs < 3.0:
                mission_ok = False
            Pc = cruise_power(v)
            t_hr = float(distance_km) / max(gs, 0.1) / 3.6
            flight_min = t_hr * 60.0
            energy_need = (Pc * t_hr + Phov * 2.0 / 60.0) * 1.15
        return {
            "M": M, "W": W, "Phov": Phov, "Ptotal": Ptotal, "Pbatt": Pbatt,
            "Tmax": Tmax, "tw": tw, "span": sp, "end_min": end_min,
            "Pc": Pc, "gs": gs, "flight_min": flight_min,
            "energy_need": energy_need, "usable": end_usable,
            "downwash": downwash, "A": A
        }

    best = None
    best_cost = 1e18
    # candidate grids - prefer compact span
    n_list = [4, 6, 8, 12, 2, 10, 16]
    chem_list = ["li-s", "li-ion", "li-po"]
    # ducted first (efficient), carbon first (light)
    for ducted in [True, False]:
        for frame in ["carbon"]:
            for n in n_list:
                side = int(math.ceil(math.sqrt(n)))
                gap = 0.30 if ducted else 0.20
                d_max_span = max_span / side - gap - 0.05  # 5cm safety
                if d_max_span > 4.0:
                    d_max_span = 4.0
                if d_max_span < 0.15:
                    continue
                # try a few diameters near max (max area best for power)
                d_cands = [d_max_span, d_max_span - 0.1, d_max_span - 0.2]
                d_cands = [d for d in d_cands if 0.1 <= d <= 4.0]
                if not d_cands:
                    continue
                for d in d_cands:
                    for chem in chem_list:
                        # sweep cruise speeds if mission
                        if distance_km is not None:
                            v_cands = [22, 25, 28, 32, 36, 40, 45, 50, 55]
                            # must beat headwind
                            v_cands = [v for v in v_cands if (v - headwind) >= 3.5 and 5 <= v <= 60]
                            if not v_cands:
                                continue
                        else:
                            v_cands = [20]
                        for vc in v_cands:
                            # estimate required powers roughly, then size motor+battery
                            # try battery sizes ascending, motor sizes ascending
                            for batt in [4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 22, 26, 30]:
                                for mot_each in [1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0, 7.0, 10.0]:
                                    if max_motor_kw is not None and mot_each > max_motor_kw + 1e-9:
                                        continue
                                    r = evaluate(n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted, vc)
                                    # hard checks with safety margins
                                    if r["span"] > max_span - 1e-9:
                                        continue
                                    if max_mass is not None and r["M"] > max_mass:
                                        continue
                                    if max_downwash is not None and r["downwash"] > max_downwash:
                                        continue
                                    if max_thrust_kn is not None and r["Tmax"] / 1000.0 > max_thrust_kn + 1e-9:
                                        continue
                                    if r["tw"] < gust_req + 0.25:
                                        continue
                                    # power headroom: 1.5x hover and 1.5x cruise + margin
                                    need_p = r["Phov"] * 1.5 * 1.15
                                    if distance_km is not None:
                                        need_p = max(need_p, r["Pc"] * 1.5 * 1.10)
                                    if r["Ptotal"] < need_p:
                                        continue
                                    if r["Pbatt"] < r["Phov"] * 1.5 * 1.10:
                                        continue
                                    if endurance_need is not None and r["end_min"] < endurance_need * 1.20:
                                        continue
                                    if distance_km is not None:
                                        if r["usable"] < r["energy_need"] * 1.18:
                                            continue
                                    # passed -> cost = mass + battery (prefer light)
                                    cost = r["M"] * 10 + batt * 2 + (0 if ducted else 5) + abs(vc - (headwind + 15)) * 0.1
                                    # prefer larger margin on energy slightly
                                    if best is None or cost < best_cost:
                                        best_cost = cost
                                        best = (n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted, vc, r)
                                # end motor
                            # end batt
    if best is None:
        # fallback: compact safe machine, max battery
        return {"n_rotors": 4, "rotor_diameter_m": 0.9, "motor_power_kw": 5.0, "battery_kwh": 14.0, "battery_chemistry": "li-s", "frame_material": "carbon", "ducted": True, "cruise_speed_m_s": 30.0}
    n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted, vc, r = best
    d = max(0.1, min(4.0, d))
    mot_each = max(0.1, mot_each)
    vc = max(5.0, min(60.0, vc))
    return {"n_rotors": int(n), "rotor_diameter_m": float(d), "motor_power_kw": float(mot_each), "battery_kwh": float(batt), "battery_chemistry": chem, "frame_material": frame, "ducted": bool(ducted), "cruise_speed_m_s": float(vc)}

def design(brief, tools):
    import math
    payload = brief.get("payload_kg", 1.0)
    max_span = brief.get("max_span_m", 10.0)
    distance = brief.get("distance_km", None)
    wind = brief.get("wind_m_s", 0.0)
    rain = brief.get("rain", False)
    planet = brief.get("planet", "earth")
    g = brief.get("gravity", 9.81)
    rho = brief.get("air_density", 1.225)
    if planet == "mars" and "gravity" not in brief:
        g = 3.71
    if planet == "mars" and "air_density" not in brief:
        rho = 0.020
    if planet == "titan" and "gravity" not in brief:
        g = 1.35
    if planet == "titan" and "air_density" not in brief:
        rho = 5.40
    rho0 = 1.225
    # chemistry props: density kwh/kg, crate, usable fraction
    chems = {
        "li-s": (0.38, 1.5),
        "li-ion": (0.25, 4.0),
        "li-po": (0.22, 5.0),
    }
    frames = ["carbon", "aluminum", "steel"]
    # frame kg per m span
    frame_k = {"carbon": 2.35, "aluminum": 3.2, "steel": 5.0}
    motor_k = 0.172  # kg per kW total
    rotor_k = 0.35  # kg per m2 per rotor (d^2)
    duct_k = 1.10  # kg per m2 per rotor
    def span_est(n, d, ducted):
        # fitted: span ~ (n/2)*d*factor
        f = 0.935 if ducted else 1.07
        # for n<=4 use 2 per row; general rows = n/2 for even, else n/2 approx
        rows = math.ceil(n / 2.0)
        # correction for many rotors: use rows
        # attempts used n=8 rows=4
        return rows * d * f + 0.1
    def mass_est(n, d, motor_kw_each, batt_kwh, chem, frame, ducted):
        bd, crate = chems[chem]
        batt_m = batt_kwh / bd
        mot_m = motor_kw_each * n * motor_k
        rot_m = n * rotor_k * d * d
        duct_m = n * duct_k * d * d if ducted else 0.0
        sp = span_est(n, d, ducted)
        fr_m = sp * frame_k[frame]
        sub = payload + batt_m + mot_m + rot_m + duct_m + fr_m
        if rain:
            sub = sub * 1.07
        return sub, sp, batt_m, mot_m, rot_m, duct_m, fr_m
    def hover_est(mass, n, d, ducted):
        W = mass * g
        area = n * math.pi * d * d / 4.0
        # baseline factor fitted on earth
        base = (W ** 1.5) / math.sqrt(area)
        # density correction: P ~ 1/sqrt(rho)
        base = base * math.sqrt(rho0 / rho)
        # calibration to match sim: unducted *k, ducted *k2
        # derived: unducted factor ~ 1.155 / sqrt? need scale to watts
        # fit: attempt2 base raw = W^1.5/sqrt(A) = 5850, hover 6760 => k=0.001155? wait units
        # Actually base above is N^1.5/m ; convert: P_ideal = W^1.5/sqrt(2*rho*A)
        # Let's use ideal then efficiency
        P_ideal = (W ** 1.5) / math.sqrt(2 * rho * area)
        if ducted:
            eff = 0.75  # ducted better
        else:
            eff = 0.55
        return P_ideal / eff / 1000.0  # kW
    def thrust_est(n, d, motor_kw_each, ducted):
        Ptot = n * motor_kw_each * 1000.0
        area = n * math.pi * d * d / 4.0
        # T from momentum: T = (2*rho*A*(eta*P)^2)^(1/3) approx
        eta = 0.6 if not ducted else 0.75
        T = (2 * rho * area * (eta * Ptot) ** 2) ** (1.0 / 3.0)
        # calibration boost to match reports (report1 higher)
        if ducted:
            T *= 1.05
        else:
            T *= 0.85
        return T  # N
    def cruise_est(hover_kw, mass, v, ducted):
        # induced drops with speed, parasite rises v^3
        # parasite area scales with mass/frame
        CdA = 0.08 + mass * 0.0015
        if ducted:
            CdA *= 1.1
        P_par = 0.5 * rho * v ** 3 * CdA / 1000.0
        if rain:
            P_par *= 1.15
        # induced factor: high speed reduces induced
        # approx induced = hover * 0.6 / sqrt(1+(v/8)^2) + hover*0.1?
        P_ind = hover_kw * 0.65 / math.sqrt(1 + (v / 7.0) ** 2) + hover_kw * 0.25
        # extra for gust control
        return P_ind + P_par
    best = None
    best_score = 1e18
    # gust T/W requirement
    need_tw = 1.5 + wind / 40.0
    # search
    chem_order = ["li-s", "li-ion", "li-po"]
    # prefer carbon
    for n in [4, 6, 8, 5, 3]:
        if n < 2 or n > 16:
            continue
        for ducted in [False, True]:
            for d in [0.6, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 0.7, 1.4]:
                if d < 0.1 or d > 4.0:
                    continue
                sp0 = span_est(n, d, ducted)
                if sp0 > max_span + 0.05:
                    continue
                for chem in chem_order:
                    bd, crate = chems[chem]
                    for batt in [8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 7]:
                        for mk in [3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0, 2.5]:
                            mass, sp, *_ = mass_est(n, d, mk, batt, chem, "carbon", ducted)
                            if sp > max_span:
                                continue
                            hov = hover_est(mass, n, d, ducted)
                            Ptot = n * mk
                            # motor headroom hover
                            if Ptot < 1.6 * hov:
                                continue
                            # battery power
                            if batt * crate < 1.6 * hov:
                                continue
                            W = mass * g
                            Tmax = thrust_est(n, d, mk, ducted)
                            tw = Tmax / W if W > 0 else 0
                            if tw < need_tw + 0.05:
                                continue
                            if distance is None:
                                # hover endurance check if needed
                                end_req = brief.get("endurance_min", None)
                                # endurance = usable / hov
                                usable = batt * 0.8
                                end_min = usable / hov * 60.0 if hov > 0 else 0
                                if end_req is not None and end_min < end_req * 1.05:
                                    continue
                                score = mass + batt * 0.1
                                if score < best_score:
                                    best_score = score
                                    best = (n, d, mk, batt, chem, "carbon", ducted, 20.0, hov, mass, sp)
                            else:
                                hw = 0.7 * wind
                                for v in [26, 28, 30, 32, 34, 25, 24, 36, 38]:
                                    if v < 5 or v > 60:
                                        continue
                                    gs = v - hw
                                    if gs < 3.2:
                                        continue
                                    cp = cruise_est(hov, mass, v, ducted)
                                    if Ptot < 1.6 * max(hov, cp):
                                        continue
                                    if batt * crate < 1.6 * max(hov, cp):
                                        continue
                                    # thrust check already, but cruise needs power
                                    t_min = distance * 1000.0 / gs / 60.0  # min
                                    e_need = (cp * (t_min / 60.0) + hov * (2.0 / 60.0)) * 1.15
                                    e_use = batt * 0.8
                                    if e_use < e_need * 1.03:
                                        continue
                                    score = e_need + mass * 0.01
                                    if score < best_score:
                                        best_score = score
                                        best = (n, d, mk, batt, chem, "carbon", ducted, float(v), hov, mass, sp)
    if best is None:
        # fallback: big safe design within span
        return {"n_rotors": 4, "rotor_diameter_m": 1.1, "motor_power_kw": 6.0, "battery_kwh": 14.0, "battery_chemistry": "li-s", "frame_material": "carbon", "ducted": False, "cruise_speed_m_s": 30.0}
    n, d, mk, batt, chem, fr, ducted, v, hov, mass, sp = best
    return {"n_rotors": int(n), "rotor_diameter_m": float(d), "motor_power_kw": float(mk), "battery_kwh": float(batt), "battery_chemistry": chem, "frame_material": fr, "ducted": bool(ducted), "cruise_speed_m_s": float(v)}

def design(brief, tools):
    import math
    payload = brief.get("payload_kg", 0)
    endurance_need = brief.get("endurance_min", 0)
    max_span = brief.get("max_span_m", 99)
    max_mass = brief.get("max_mass_kg", 1e9)
    rho = brief.get("air_density", 1.225)
    grav = brief.get("gravity", 9.81)

    # estimated constants fitted to simulator sample
    e_dens = {"li-po": 0.17, "li-ion": 0.25, "li-s": 0.35}  # kWh/kg
    c_rate = {"li-po": 25.0, "li-ion": 8.0, "li-s": 5.0}
    motor_kg_per_kw = 0.151
    rotor_k = 0.352  # kg per d^2 per rotor
    frame_per_m = {"carbon": 6.3, "aluminum": 9.5, "steel": 15.0}
    duct_k = 1.2  # kg per d^2 per ducted rotor
    usable = 0.8
    hover_factor = 1.81  # inefficiency over ideal momentum
    thrust_coeff = 0.673  # T = coeff*(2*rho*A*P^2)^(1/3)
    duct_power_gain = 0.78  # ducted uses less hover power
    duct_thrust_gain = 1.25

    def ceil_sqrt(n):
        import math
        s = int(math.ceil(math.sqrt(n)))
        return s

    def estimate(n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted):
        A = n * math.pi * d * d / 4.0
        # span estimate: grid packing + gap; ducted packs tighter
        cols = ceil_sqrt(n)
        gap = 1.05 if ducted else 1.25
        span = cols * d * gap
        # masses
        batt_m = batt / e_dens[chem] if batt > 0 else 0
        mot_m = n * mot_each * motor_kg_per_kw
        rot_m = n * rotor_k * d * d
        frame_m = frame_per_m[frame] * span * (1.0 + 0.05 * n)
        # frame scaling with n arms: keep simple
        # use span-based only to avoid overestimate; correct:
        frame_m = frame_per_m[frame] * span
        duct_m = n * duct_k * d * d if ducted else 0.0
        total = payload + batt_m + mot_m + rot_m + frame_m + duct_m
        W = total * grav
        P_ideal = (W ** 1.5) / math.sqrt(2 * rho * A) / 1000.0  # kW
        hover = P_ideal * hover_factor
        if ducted:
            hover *= duct_power_gain
        Ptot = n * mot_each
        Tmax = thrust_coeff * ((2 * rho * A * (Ptot * 1000.0) ** 2) ** (1.0 / 3.0))
        if ducted:
            Tmax *= duct_thrust_gain
        tw = Tmax / W if W > 0 else 0
        endu = batt * usable / hover * 60.0 if hover > 0 else 0
        batt_p = batt * c_rate[chem]
        return {
            "mass": total, "span": span, "hover": hover, "Ptot": Ptot,
            "tw": tw, "endu": endu, "batt_p": batt_p, "A": A
        }

    best = None
    # prefer ducted carbon li-po for this high-power compact suit
    for ducted in [True, False]:
        for chem in ["li-po", "li-ion", "li-s"]:
            for frame in ["carbon"]:
                for n in [8, 6, 4, 10, 12]:
                    for d in [0.4, 0.45, 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.65, 0.7]:
                        for mot_each in [10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 20]:
                            for batt in [4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 8.0]:
                                e = estimate(n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted)
                                if e["span"] > max_span - 0.05:
                                    continue
                                if e["mass"] > max_mass - 2:
                                    continue
                                if e["tw"] < 1.60:
                                    continue
                                if e["Ptot"] < 1.6 * e["hover"]:
                                    continue
                                if e["batt_p"] < 1.6 * e["hover"]:
                                    continue
                                if endurance_need and e["endu"] < endurance_need + 0.5:
                                    continue
                                # feasible, minimize mass
                                score = e["mass"]
                                if best is None or score < best[0]:
                                    best = (score, n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted, e)
    if best is None:
        # fallback: max power compact
        return {"n_rotors": 8, "rotor_diameter_m": 0.5, "motor_power_kw": 15.0, "battery_kwh": 7.0, "battery_chemistry": "li-po", "frame_material": "carbon", "ducted": True, "cruise_speed_m_s": 15.0}
    _, n, d, mot_each, batt, chem, frame, ducted, e = best
    return {"n_rotors": int(n), "rotor_diameter_m": float(d), "motor_power_kw": float(mot_each), "battery_kwh": float(batt), "battery_chemistry": chem, "frame_material": frame, "ducted": bool(ducted), "cruise_speed_m_s": 15.0}

rejected.name: span_first_rotor_sizing
rejected.description: Size rotor diameter to meet span limit first, then upsize power system
rejected.content: When a max span/gate limit applies, fit geometry first: choose rotor_diameter so that predicted span < limit (use span ~2.5x rotor_diameter for a quad, smaller allowance per rotor as n_rotors grows). Shrinking rotors raises disk loading and hover power as ~1/sqrt(area), so compensate by upsizing battery kWh for endurance and motors+battery-C for >=1.5x hover power and thrust/weight >=1.5.

rejected.name: split_disk_area_to_fit_span
rejected.description: Add rotors to fit span limit while preserving disk area for downwash/power
rejected.content: When span is over limit but downwash/power needs large disk area, increase rotor count (e.g. 2->6-8) and shrink diameter to hold total area A=n*pi*d^2/4 roughly constant. Downwash and hover power follow momentum theory v=sqrt(W/(2*rho*A)), so constant A keeps them safe while span scales ~sqrt(n)*d and shrinks; always retarget thrust/weight to >=1.6 and power to >=1.6x hover to avoid borderline 1.50 rounding fails.

rejected.name: keep_1p5x_thrust_and_power_margins
rejected.description: Guarantee lift and electrical headroom on powered-lift designs
rejected.content: Size the propulsion system so max thrust / weight >=1.5, total motor power >=1.5x hover power, and battery max discharge >=1.5x hover power. Apply all three checks together before submitting; if any fails, upsize rotors/motors/battery respectively rather than trading one margin for another.

rejected.name: choose_battery_by_required_c_rate
rejected.description: Select battery chemistry by required discharge C-rate when sizing for endurance
rejected.content: For battery-powered hover/lift machines, size chemistry for power as well as energy: required C = (1.5 x hover_power_kW) / battery_kWh must be < chemistry continuous C-rating. When endurance needs <1 kWh but hover needs ~1 kW, required C is ~2-3C so choose Li-ion (~4C) over higher-energy Li-S (~1.5C), otherwise battery_power fails despite passing endurance.
